technical.en: The technical specifications of the engine were revised after extensive laboratory testing.
technical.zh: 经过大量实验室测试后，该发动机的技术规格得到了修订。

technical.en: Her paper addresses the technical limitations of current machine learning systems.
technical.zh: 她的论文探讨了当前机器学习系统的技术局限。

technical.en: This technical training course is designed for newly hired engineering staff.
technical.zh: 这门技术培训课程是为新入职的工程人员设计的。

theoretical.en: The theoretical framework provides a foundation for later empirical studies.
theoretical.zh: 这一理论框架为随后的实证研究奠定了基础。

theoretical.en: Her argument is theoretically sound but lacks convincing experimental evidence.
theoretical.zh: 她的论点在理论上是合理的，但缺乏令人信服的实验证据。

theoretical.en: In theoretical terms, such a model assumes unlimited computing power.
theoretical.zh: 从理论角度看，这样一个模型假定了无限的计算能力。

traditional.en: Traditional teaching methods often place greater emphasis on memorization than discussion.
traditional.zh: 传统教学方法往往更强调记忆而非讨论。

traditional.en: Many villages still depend on traditional farming practices rather than modern machinery.
traditional.zh: 许多村庄仍依赖传统耕作方式而非现代机械。

traditional.en: The ceremony follows a traditional pattern that has changed little over centuries.
traditional.zh: 这场典礼遵循着数百年来鲜有变化的传统模式。

typical.en: A typical application of this method appears in early childhood education.
typical.zh: 这一方法的一个典型应用出现在幼儿教育领域。

typical.en: The results were typical of studies conducted in similar laboratories.
typical.zh: 这些结果与在类似实验室开展的研究结果一致。

typical.en: Students typically require additional support when facing a typical mathematical problem.
typical.zh: 学生在遇到典型的数学问题时通常需要额外帮助。

universal.en: The tool was designed for universal use across all major platforms.
universal.zh: 该工具专为在所有主流平台上通用而设计。

universal.en: Such a universal claim is difficult to support with limited observational data.
universal.zh: 如此普适的结论很难用有限的观察数据来支持。

universal.en: The researcher proposed a universal grammar shared by every human language.
universal.zh: 研究者提出了一套所有人类语言共有的普遍语法。

useful.en: These recordings proved useful for studying regional differences in pronunciation.
useful.zh: 这些录音对研究发音的地区差异很有用。

useful.en: A short summary is often more useful to a busy committee than a long report.
useful.zh: 对忙碌的委员会而言，一份简短的摘要往往比长篇报告更有用。

useful.en: Your feedback was useful in identifying weaknesses in the experimental design.
useful.zh: 你的反馈有助于发现实验设计中的薄弱环节。

usual.en: The usual practice is to submit the proposal before the end of the semester.
usual.zh: 通常的做法是在学期结束前提交提案。

usual.en: This method performs better than usual in low light conditions.
usual.zh: 这种方法在弱光条件下的表现优于平常。

usual.en: Participants reported the usual complaints about noise in the reading room.
usual.zh: 参与者抱怨了阅览室常见的噪音问题。

valid.en: The judge ruled that the appeal was valid and allowed the case to proceed.
valid.zh: 法官裁定该上诉有效，允许案件继续进行。

valid.en: A valid conclusion requires adequate data and a sound statistical method.
valid.zh: 有效的结论需要充分的数据和可靠的统计方法。

valid.en: His argument that the treaty remains valid was rejected by the committee.
valid.zh: 他关于条约仍然有效的论点被委员会否决。

valuable.en: The archive contains valuable records of early industrial production.
valuable.zh: 该档案馆保存着早期的工业生产记录，具有重要价值。

valuable.en: Students exchanged valuable feedback before the final examination.
valuable.zh: 学生在期末考试前交换了宝贵的反馈意见。

valuable.en: The old manuscript proved valuable for tracing the origins of the language.
valuable.zh: 这部古老手稿对于追溯该语言的起源很有价值。

various.en: The researchers applied various methods to confirm the surprising experimental result.
various.zh: 研究者采用各种方法证实了这一令人惊讶的实验结果。

various.en: The book discusses the various stages involved in language acquisition.
various.zh: 该书讨论了语言习得所涉及的各个阶段。

various.en: Failure may arise for various reasons, ranging from poor design to insufficient funding.
various.zh: 失败可能出于各种原因，从设计不良到资金不足不等。

wide.en: The survey covered a wide range of industries and geographic regions.
wide.zh: 这项调查涵盖了广泛的行业和地理区域。

wide.en: The reform retained wide public support despite the committee's concerns.
wide.zh: 尽管委员会有所担忧，该改革依然获得广泛的公众支持。

wide.en: A wide gap continues to separate theoretical teaching from classroom practice.
wide.zh: 理论教学与课堂实践之间仍存在巨大差距。

wrong.en: The model gave the wrong answer because the input data was corrupted.
wrong.zh: 由于输入数据损坏，模型给出了错误答案。

wrong.en: A wrong measurement early in the process distorted every subsequent calculation.
wrong.zh: 流程早期的一次错误测量使随后的每一次计算都失真。

wrong.en: Something is clearly wrong with the balance, since the readings keep drifting.
wrong.zh: 天平显然出了问题，因为读数不断漂移。

actually.en: The enzyme actually operates at a much lower temperature than expected.
actually.zh: 这种酶的实际工作温度远低于预期。

actually.en: The program was supposed to end last year but actually continues today.
actually.zh: 该项目原定去年结束，但实际上一直持续至今。

actually.en: Contrary to popular belief, the ancient building actually served as a granary.
actually.zh: 与普遍看法相反，这座古建筑实际上曾用作粮仓。

apparently.en: The manuscript apparently reached a university library in the nineteenth century.
apparently.zh: 这部手稿据称在 19 世纪到达了一所大学图书馆。

apparently.en: Apparently nobody had checked the calculations before the report was published.
apparently.zh: 据说在报告发表前没有人检查过这些计算。

apparently.en: The device apparently tolerates temperatures that its manufacturer never specified.
apparently.zh: 该装置似乎能承受制造商未曾说明的温度。

approximately.en: Approximately forty percent of the participants reported regular headaches.
approximately.zh: 大约 40% 的参与者报告经常头痛。

approximately.en: The journey takes approximately six hours by train and two by plane.
approximately.zh: 这段旅程乘火车大约六小时，乘飞机大约两小时。

approximately.en: Its mass is approximately equal to that of the entire student population.
approximately.zh: 其质量大约相当于全体学生的总和。

basically.en: The two proposals are basically identical apart from their final section.
basically.zh: 除最后一节之外，这两个提案基本相同。

basically.en: Basically, the experiment tests whether the new compound reduces inflammation.
basically.zh: 基本上，这个实验检验的是该新化合物能否减轻炎症。

basically.en: The engine is basically a 1990 design fitted with a modern fuel system.
basically.zh: 这台发动机基本上是 1990 年的设计，只是装上了现代燃油系统。

clearly.en: The findings clearly demonstrate the need for further field research.
clearly.zh: 这些发现清楚地表明了进一步开展野外研究的必要性。

clearly.en: It is clearly stated in the appendix that the samples were frozen.
clearly.zh: 附录中明确说明了样本经过冷冻处理。

clearly.en: The audience could clearly see that the speaker had lost confidence.
clearly.zh: 观众清楚地看出演讲者已经失去信心。

closely.en: The two theories are closely related but differ in their basic assumptions.
closely.zh: 这两种理论密切相关，但在基本假设上有所不同。

closely.en: Researchers closely examined the manuscript for signs of earlier copying.
closely.zh: 研究者仔细检查了这部手稿，看是否有早期传抄的痕迹。

closely.en: The supply of clean water closely follows the seasonal pattern of rainfall.
closely.zh: 清洁水的供应与季节性降雨模式紧密同步变化。

considerably.en: The new method considerably reduced the time required for each measurement.
considerably.zh: 新方法大幅缩短了每次测量所需的时间。

considerably.en: Prices in the region have risen considerably since the beginning of the year.
considerably.zh: 自年初以来，该地区的物价已大幅上涨。

considerably.en: Her second book is considerably longer than the first one.
considerably.zh: 她的第二本书比第一本长得多。

consistently.en: The laboratory has consistently published its data in an open archive.
consistently.zh: 该实验室始终如一地将数据发布在开放档案库中。

consistently.en: Students who attended the workshop consistently performed better in the final exam.
consistently.zh: 参加研讨会的学生在期末考试中始终表现得更好。

consistently.en: He consistently argues that theory should guide experimental design.
consistently.zh: 他一贯主张理论应当指导实验设计。

constantly.en: The village is constantly exposed to winds carrying salt from the sea.
constantly.zh: 该村庄不断受到从海上带来盐分的海风侵袭。

constantly.en: She is constantly revising her manuscript in response to new evidence.
constantly.zh: 她不断根据新证据修改自己的手稿。

constantly.en: Dust and vibration constantly interfere with measurements at the old laboratory.
constantly.zh: 灰尘和振动不断干扰着旧实验室的测量工作。

currently.en: The researchers are currently analyzing data collected over five years.
currently.zh: 研究人员目前正在分析五年来收集的数据。

currently.en: Currently, no consensus exists on how the disease spreads.
currently.zh: 目前，对于这种疾病如何传播尚无共识。

currently.en: The project currently employs twelve researchers and two field teams.
currently.zh: 该项目目前拥有 12 名研究人员和两支野外考察队。

deliberately.en: The authors deliberately excluded studies without a control group.
deliberately.zh: 作者有意排除了缺少对照组的研究。

deliberately.en: The error was deliberately concealed from the review committee.
deliberately.zh: 这一错误被故意向评审委员会隐瞒。

deliberately.en: Plant species were deliberately selected to test the hypothesis in saline soil.
deliberately.zh: 研究人员有意挑选植物物种，在盐碱土壤中检验该假设。

effectively.en: The new policy effectively reduces waiting times for rural patients.
effectively.zh: 新政策有效减少了农村患者的等候时间。

effectively.en: Effectively, the two departments were operating as a single unit.
effectively.zh: 实际上，这两个部门是在作为一个整体运作。

effectively.en: Clear documentation helps new staff work effectively within the laboratory.
effectively.zh: 清晰的文档有助于新员工在实验室有效开展工作。

eventually.en: After repeated failures, the team eventually identified the source of contamination.
eventually.zh: 经过多次失败，团队最终确定了污染的来源。

eventually.en: The two documents eventually proved to describe the same historical event.
eventually.zh: 这两份文献最终被证明描述的是同一历史事件。

eventually.en: Passengers eventually reached safety once the smoke cleared from the corridor.
eventually.zh: 走廊里的烟散去后，乘客们最终到达了安全地带。

exactly.en: The measured value agrees exactly with the figure published last year.
exactly.zh: 测得数值与去年公布的数字完全一致。

exactly.en: She cannot explain exactly why the reaction failed in three trials.
exactly.zh: 她无法确切解释该反应为何在三次试验中失败。

exactly.en: That is exactly the problem our current experimental design cannot solve.
exactly.zh: 这恰恰是我们现有实验设计无法解决的问题。

frequently.en: Researchers frequently publish corrections when a reference list contains errors.
frequently.zh: 当参考文献出现错误时，研究人员经常发布更正。

frequently.en: This species frequently rests on the underside of broad leaves.
frequently.zh: 该物种经常栖息在宽大叶片的背面。

frequently.en: The two laboratories frequently exchange samples to verify their measurements.
frequently.zh: 这两个实验室经常交换样本以核验彼此的测量结果。

generally.en: Generally, tropical soils lose nutrients quickly under heavy rainfall.
generally.zh: 一般来说，热带土壤在暴雨中会迅速流失养分。

generally.en: The paper is generally accepted as a landmark in the field.
generally.zh: 这篇论文被普遍视为该领域的里程碑。

generally.en: Most students, generally speaking, underestimate the time needed for revision.
generally.zh: 总的来说，多数学生低估了修订所需的时间。

greatly.en: The restoration greatly improved the building's resistance to rainfall.
greatly.zh: 这项修复工程极大提高了建筑物对雨水的抵抗力。

greatly.en: Her research greatly influenced how schools teach early numeracy.
greatly.zh: 她的研究极大影响了学校开展早期数学教育的方式。

greatly.en: Costs have greatly increased since the currency was last revalued.
greatly.zh: 自上次货币重新估值以来，成本已大幅上升。

increasingly.en: Universities are increasingly relying on online journals rather than print subscriptions.
increasingly.zh: 大学正越来越多地依赖在线期刊而非纸质订阅。

increasingly.en: Renewable energy has become increasingly central to public debate.
increasingly.zh: 可再生能源在公共讨论中日益占据核心地位。

increasingly.en: Small publishers are increasingly turning to print-on-demand services to reduce costs.
increasingly.zh: 小型出版商正越来越多地转向按需印刷服务以降低成本。

mainly.en: The funding comes mainly from national research councils and philanthropic foundations.
mainly.zh: 这笔资金主要来自国家研究委员会和慈善基金会。

mainly.en: Interest in the archive is driven mainly by graduate students studying local history.
mainly.zh: 人们对该档案的兴趣主要由研究地方史的研究生推动。

mainly.en: The delay was caused mainly by delays in customs clearance of equipment shipments.
mainly.zh: 延误主要是由于设备清关缓慢造成的。

mostly.en: The respondents were mostly graduate students from the sciences and engineering.
mostly.zh: 受访者大多是来自理工科的研究生。

mostly.en: The rock consists mostly of quartz with small amounts of mica and feldspar.
mostly.zh: 这种岩石主要由石英组成，含有少量云母和长石。

mostly.en: Her findings have mostly been confirmed by independent laboratories in other countries.
mostly.zh: 她的研究结果大多已被其他国家的独立实验室证实。

normally.en: Normally, the archive receives about two hundred inquiries every month.
normally.zh: 通常情况下，该档案馆每月收到约 200 件查询。

normally.en: On normally quiet weekdays, the reading room fills with exam candidates.
normally.zh: 在通常很安静的工作日，阅览室里坐满了备考的学生。

normally.en: Samples are normally stored for five years before being permanently destroyed.
normally.zh: 样本通常保存五年，之后被永久销毁。

obviously.en: It is obviously impossible to complete such a survey within two weeks.
obviously.zh: 显然不可能在两周内完成这样一份问卷。

obviously.en: The equipment was obviously damaged during its long journey by sea.
obviously.zh: 这台设备显然在长途海运中受损了。

obviously.en: The written record and the oral accounts obviously contradict each other.
obviously.zh: 书面记录与口述证词显然彼此矛盾。

particularly.en: This method is particularly useful for analyzing very small samples.
particularly.zh: 这种方法对于分析极小的样品特别有用。

particularly.en: The second chapter is particularly important for students beginning the course.
particularly.zh: 第二章对刚开始这门课程的学生尤为重要。

particularly.en: The southern coast is particularly vulnerable to rising sea levels.
particularly.zh: 南部海岸对海平面上升尤其脆弱。

probably.en: The missing instruments are probably stored in the basement archive.
probably.zh: 丢失的仪器很可能存放在地下室的档案柜里。

probably.en: Reading the correspondence will probably reveal what actually happened that week.
probably.zh: 查阅这些书信很可能会揭示那一周究竟发生了什么。

probably.en: The experiment will probably need to be repeated with older specimens.
probably.zh: 这个实验很可能需要用更古老的标本重新进行。

quickly.en: The software quickly identified every citation that referenced a missing source.
quickly.zh: 该软件迅速找出了所有引用缺失来源的引文。

quickly.en: Bacteria multiplied quickly once the temperature exceeded thirty degrees.
quickly.zh: 温度超过 30 度后，细菌迅速繁殖。

quickly.en: The team quickly revised its plan after the first grant application was rejected.
quickly.zh: 首次资助申请被拒后，团队迅速修订了计划。

rarely.en: Such specimens are rarely found outside a few protected mountain valleys.
rarely.zh: 这类标本除少数受保护的山谷外很少能见到。

rarely.en: The archive rarely lends original documents to external researchers.
rarely.zh: 该档案馆很少将原件借给外部研究人员。

rarely.en: Errors in the early editions are rarely mentioned in modern introductions.
rarely.zh: 早期版本中的错误在现代导言中很少被提及。

recently.en: A newly discovered manuscript recently reshaped our understanding of early trade.
recently.zh: 一部新近发现的手稿不久前重塑了我们对早期贸易的理解。

recently.en: The laboratory recently received funding to digitize its entire archive.
recently.zh: 该实验室最近获得资助，将对其全部档案进行数字化。

recently.en: Two former students recently founded a company developing low-cost sensors.
recently.zh: 两名前学生最近创办了一家开发低成本传感器的公司。

regularly.en: The committee regularly meets to review ongoing research and budgets.
regularly.zh: 委员会定期开会审查正在进行的研究和预算。

regularly.en: Trees regularly lose leaves during the dry season in this climate.
regularly.zh: 在这种气候下，树木在旱季经常落叶。

regularly.en: Students who regularly visit the archive tend to develop better research skills.
regularly.zh: 经常到档案馆的学生往往培养出更好的研究技能。
